mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical MESA Adaptive Moving Average crossing its Following Adaptive Moving Average identifies a phase-adaptive trend transition; follow the new relation for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when MAMA crosses strictly above FAMA; short when MAMA crosses strictly below FAMA
mechanism.why_distinct: MAMA derives an adaptive alpha from Hilbert-style detrending, in-phase/quadrature components, homodyne period discrimination, and phase change; FAMA follows at half that alpha. It is not a fixed-period average, ZLEMA, raw return, oscillator threshold, channel, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the official indicator adapts smoothing to market volatility and phase while completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse phase-adaptive MAMA/FAMA crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.mama: exact online LEAN MAMA state and constants
features.event: finite MAMA newly strictly above FAMA from not above gives +1; newly strictly below from not below gives -1
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: all rolling, phase, period, MAMA, FAMA, and crossover state resets after any invalid completed four-hour bar

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official LEAN MAMA(0.5,0.05)/FAMA crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no fast/slow limit, formula, warmup, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers MESA Adaptive Moving Average; QuantConnect LEAN canonical implementation
external_basis.fixed_definition: median price=(high+low)/2; LEAN Hilbert/detrender and homodyne discriminator constants 0.0962,0.5769; period constrained by 0.67x/1.5x prior and [6,50]; alpha=max(0.05,0.5/deltaPhase) with deltaPhase floor 1; MAMA recursion and FAMA half-alpha recursion; warmup 33 bars
external_basis.selection_use: official default fastLimit=0.5, slowLimit=0.05, formula, warmup, and MAMA/FAMA crossover only; no incidence or outcomes
